summary: Frontend-only testing of new 'Galería Escenarios Deportivos' (scenarios_gallery_2) carousel on /eventos and the corresponding Admin CMS subsection 7B. All acceptance criteria pass. Section renders between 'scenarios-section' and 'premiacion-section' with no title/subtitle, only the gold-accent carousel. Prev/next navigation cycles images correctly. Admin panel at /admin/home exposes subsection '7B. Galería Escenarios Deportivos — carrusel de fotos (sin título)' with all expected data-testids (scenarios-gallery-2, -list, -input, -btn, -remove-N, -left-N, -right-N). PUT /api/home-settings save returns 200. Existing scenarios-section and premiacion-section carousels remain intact (no regressions).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminHomeSettings.jsx is ~600+ lines with many inline SubSection blocks. Consider extracting SubSection 7B (and siblings) into standalone components to improve readability and reuse.

Eventos.jsx conditional rendering `{ev.scenarios_gallery_2 && ev.scenarios_gallery_2.length > 0 && ...}` is correct; make sure DEFAULT_EVENTOS_CONFIG in backend always returns an empty array (not undefined) to avoid frontend needing null-safety in future callers.
test_credentials: admin@futuresoccercup.com / FSCAdmin2025! (works, login returns 200 with admin role)
seed_data_creation: None. 3 preexisting unsplash images in scenarios_gallery_2 (from previous testing) were used and left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public routes: /eventos scenarios-gallery-2-section testids [-carousel,-prev,-next]. Admin subsection: scenarios-gallery-2 (with -list, -input hidden file, -btn 'Agregar más', -remove-N, -left-N, -right-N). Save PUT /api/home-settings (no /admin prefix) returns 200. Admin auth via /login modal (POST /api/auth/login → cookie-based). To test file upload: use page.set_input_files on hidden [data-testid='scenarios-gallery-2-input']; the file is uploaded via POST /api/upload upon Save click, and its returned URL appended to scenarios_gallery_2 before PUT /api/home-settings. Note: /admin/home occasionally gets stuck on 'Cargando...' after rapid consecutive navigations — retry with domcontentloaded + polling for [data-testid='scenarios-gallery-2'].
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works as specified.
